_comment: Manually maintained -- there is no public API for fire restriction stage (InciWeb and the Forest Service publish this as text/press releases, not structured data). Update this file whenever La Plata County / San Juan National Forest changes the stage. Check: https://www.fs.usda.gov/main/sanjuan/alerts-notices and the La Plata County Sheriff's Office Facebook page. This is the ONE file in this repo you should expect to hand-edit regularly.
source: San Juan National Forest / La Plata County

nearby_wildfires._comment: Optional. Set count to 0 to omit the situational line entirely. If you set a count > 0, write the whole 'note' sentence yourself -- the bot posts it verbatim, it does not calculate distances.
